map.本地静态识别常见乱码特征，提供可读性修复建议。: Statically detects common garbled-text patterns locally and suggests readability fixes.
map.依据字节序列特征推测文本的字符编码。: Infers a text's character encoding from byte-sequence features.
map.：UTF-8 的多字节序列有严格规则，出现非法序列即可排除 UTF-8。: : UTF-8 multi-byte sequences follow strict rules, so an illegal sequence rules UTF-8 out.
map.：对双字节编码（GBK/Big5/Shift-JIS）用字频与双字节分布做概率判: : for double-byte encodings (GBK/Big5/Shift-JIS), use character frequency and double-byte distribution for a probabilistic judgment.
map.：推测并非确定结论，短文本极易误判，需结合语言上下文人工确认。: : a guess is not a firm conclusion; short texts are easily misjudged, so confirm manually with language context.
map.拿到一段不知编码的文本（GBK/UTF-8/Big5）时推断其字符集。: Infers the charset of text whose encoding you do not know (GBK, UTF-8, Big5).
map.处理乱码文件：导入 CSV 前先探测编码，确认是 UTF-8、GBK 还是带 B: Handling garbled files: probe the encoding before importing a CSV, confirm whether it is UTF-8, GBK or UTF-8 with a BOM, then read it with the correct encoding so the whole table does not fill with question marks or wrong characters.
map.输入 GBK 字节 `C4E3BAC3` → 识别为 GBK，解码得“你好”（而: Input the GBK bytes `C4E3BAC3` → detected as GBK, decoding to "nǐ hǎo" rather than the garbled text UTF-8 would produce.
map.短文本可能误判，建议结合语言与来源综合判断。: Short texts may be misjudged; judge the language and the source together.
map.为什么有时判断不准？: Why is the detection sometimes wrong?
map.因为短文本信息量不足：GBK 与 Big5 的字节区间大面积重叠，纯 ASCII: Because short texts carry too little information: the byte ranges of GBK and Big5 overlap heavily, plain ASCII is valid under almost every encoding, and UTF-8 and Latin-1 cannot be told apart without a BOM. The tool can only return the most probable guess; the reliable approach is to combine language priors (Chinese favors GBK or UTF-8) with the source of the data, or simply ask the data provider to declare the encoding.
